description: Aries decan 2 (March 31 to April 9): personality, love, work and growth, with the Sun as sub-ruler of the second ten degrees of Aries.
answer: In Western astrology, the second decan of Aries covers 10° to 19° of the sign, roughly March 31 to April 9, with the Sun as its sub-ruler beside Mars. It is read as martial courage warmed by the sun's pride and generosity. Decans are a traditional refinement of the Sun sign.

sections.heading: Aries decan 2 personality
paragraphs: Between 10 and 19 degrees, Aries takes on a sunnier tone. The Sun is the sub-ruler of this middle decan, borrowing a measure of Leo into the Ram's character, and the result is usually read as fire with an audience in mind. These natives still charge ahead, but they care more about what the charge means and who is watching. A sense of honour runs through the descriptions: keeping one's word, protecting the underdog, standing visibly behind a choice. Where the first decan acts on instinct, this one tends to act on conviction, and wants that conviction to be seen and respected.

The Sun's influence adds warmth, playfulness and a theatrical streak that can make these Rams magnetic company. They often enjoy leading, not because control appeals but because they genuinely believe they can make the experience better for everyone. That belief is frequently justified, and occasionally a little inflated. Pride is the double-edged trait here: it fuels generosity and loyalty, and it can also make criticism sting longer than expected. Traditional writers linked this decan with nobility of purpose. In everyday terms, it often shows as someone who would rather be admired for doing the right thing than merely for winning.

sections.heading: Aries decan 2 in love and at work
paragraphs: In love, the second-decan Ram is often openly affectionate and a touch dramatic, preferring grand gestures to quiet hints. They tend to court with enthusiasm, remember the big occasions and want a partner they feel proud to stand beside. Appreciation is the currency that matters: noticed effort keeps them devoted, while indifference cools them fast. Jealousy can appear when they feel upstaged rather than when they feel threatened. Relationships flourish when both people get room to shine, and when this Aries remembers that a partner's quieter forms of love still count, even without applause.

Professionally, this decan tends to gravitate towards visible leadership. Team captain, creative director, founder, presenter, advocate: roles with a public face and a clear mission suit the Sun's influence. They motivate others by example and by sheer warmth, and they usually prefer to be trusted than micromanaged. Recognition matters, so cultures that celebrate wins openly keep them engaged. Their blind spot can be credit-sharing; a team that feels overshadowed may disengage. Naming colleagues' contributions out loud is both generous and strategic for this Aries, and it multiplies their influence.

sections.heading: Dates and sub-ruler of Aries decan 2: what the Sun adds
paragraphs: The second decan covers 10° to 19° of Aries, which in most years means birthdays from March 31 to April 9. Its sub-ruler, the Sun, comes from Leo, the next fire sign after Aries, so this decan borrows a little of Leo's character while staying Aries at heart. The other two decans of Aries belong to Mars (decan 1) and Jupiter (decan 3). Because decans are measured in degrees rather than days, the calendar dates drift by a day or so between years.

The Sun brings warmth, pride and a need to be seen. Where it sub-rules, astrologers look for generosity, creative confidence and a wish to lead from the front, along with sensitivity to whether effort is noticed and appreciated. Solar decans are often linked with performance, visibility and a strong personal signature, and their usual lesson is to share the stage. Set against Aries's courage, initiative, directness and a restless urge to begin, that Sun note shifts the emphasis without changing the sign underneath.

sections.heading: Growth for Aries decan 2
paragraphs: Growth for this decan often centres on separating self-worth from applause. Try keeping a private record of things done well that nobody else noticed, as a reminder that value does not depend on witnesses. When feedback stings, wait a day before responding and look for the one useful sentence inside it. Practise supporting someone else's moment without adding your own story. Creative outlets that are purely for pleasure, rather than performance, can restore energy. The Sun's best expression here is warmth that lights other people up, not only the person at the centre.

Within Aries, decan 1 leans towards pioneering drive in its purest, most impatient form and decan 3 leans towards restless fire reaching for distant horizons and bigger meanings. A decan is one layer of a chart among many, so the Moon, rising sign and houses can strengthen or soften everything described here. These notes work best as prompts for reflection: notice which lines ring true, which feel foreign, and what that contrast suggests.

faq.question: What does the Sun as sub-ruler add to the second decan of Aries?
faq.answer: The Sun lends this middle stretch of Aries some of Leo's warmth, pride and flair. Natives are often described as leaders who want their courage to mean something, generous and loyal, with a stronger need for recognition than first-decan Rams and a theatrical, big-hearted style.

faq.question: What are the dates of Aries decan 2?
faq.answer: In most years March 31 to April 9, the days when the Sun is between 10° and 19° of Aries. Birthdays at either end can fall in the neighbouring decan in some years.

faq.question: What planet rules Aries decan 2?
faq.answer: The Sun. In the triplicity system each fire sign's decans take the rulers of the fire signs in order, starting with Aries's own ruler, Mars.
